description:
Upgrade your bathroom with a recessed toilet paper holder that saves space with a streamlined, built-in look in Polished Chrome, which delivers a bright, mirror-like sheen that coordinates effortlessly with chrome faucets and modern fixtures. Crafted from brass and designed for in-wall installation, it helps keep your bath area looking clean and coordinated.

Highlights:
- Polished Chrome coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean installation
- Designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
- Includes recessed toilet paper holder and all installation hardware

Specs:
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Recessed (in-wall)
- Overall size: 6.125 in L x 4 in W x 6.125 in H
- Projection: 4 in
- Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Collection: Carolina
